title: Test-Time Confidence Adaptation under RL-Induced Trajectory Shift
abstract: arXiv:2610.35500v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trajectory-based confidence estimation has shown promising performance for large language models (LLMs) by leveraging rich signals from their reasoning processes. However, we find that such confidence estimators can degrade substantially after agentic reinforcement learning (Agentic RL) as it induces substantial shifts in the reasoning trajectories. More importantly, despite these shifts, we uncover a reliability structure that is largely preserved across Base and RL models: $\textbf{more}$ $\textbf{stable}$ $\textbf{trajectories}$ $\textbf{remain}$ $\textbf{more}$ $\textbf{likely}$ $\textbf{to}$ $\textbf{produce}$ $\textbf{correct}$ $\textbf{answers}$. This preserved relationship provides a transferable, label-free reliability signal for post-RL confidence adaptation. translated_title: 强化学习引起的轨迹偏移下的测试时置信度自适应
translated_abstract: 基于轨迹的置信度估计通过利用大语言模型（LLM）推理过程中的丰富信号，展现出了良好的性能。然而，我们发现这类置信度估计器在经过智能体强化学习（Agentic RL）后会显著退化，因为强化学习会引起推理轨迹的大幅偏移。更重要的是，尽管存在这些偏移，我们揭示了一个在基础模型和强化学习模型之间基本保持不变的可靠性结构：更稳定的轨迹更有可能产生正确答案。这种得以保持的关系为强化学习后的置信度自适应提供了一种可迁移的、无需标签的可靠性信号。基于这一发现，我们提出了StaR-TTA，一个以稳定性为指导的无需标签的测试时置信度自适应框架。StaR-TTA联合从正确（答案）中学习……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文发现尽管智能体强化学习会导致推理轨迹偏移并使置信度估计器性能退化，但“更稳定的轨迹更可能产生正确答案”这一可靠性结构在基础模型与强化学习模型间依然保持，据此提出了无需标签的稳定性引导测试时置信度自适应框架StaR-TTA。
en_tdlr: The paper reveals that although agentic RL shifts reasoning trajectories and degrades confidence estimators, the reliability structure that more stable trajectories are more likely to produce correct answers is preserved across Base and RL models, and proposes StaR-TTA, a stability-guided label-free test-time confidence adaptation framework.
